title: Constant-Speed Cruise Follow
description: ASAM OpenSCENARIO 1.2 car-following baseline with an Ego vehicle cruising behind a steady-speed lead vehicle on a straight two-lane OpenDRIVE highway.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OpenSCENARIO>
  <FileHeader revMajor="1" revMinor="2" date="2026-11-24T12:00:00" description="Constant-Speed Cruise Follow Scenario" author="Ansatz"/>
  <ParameterDeclarations>
    <ParameterDeclaration name="CruiseSpeed" parameterType="double" value="25.0"/>
  </ParameterDeclarations>
  <RoadNetwork>
    <LogicFile filepath="straight_road.xodr"/>
  </RoadNetwork>
  <Entities>
    <ScenarioObject name="Ego">
      <Vehicle name="Ego" vehicleCategory="car">
        <Performance maxSpeed="55.0" maxAcceleration="3.5" maxDeceleration="8.5"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="1.4" y="0.0" z="0.7"/><Dimensions width="1.85" length="4.6" height="1.45"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
    <ScenarioObject name="LeadVehicle">
      <Vehicle name="LeadVehicle" vehicleCategory="car">
        <Performance maxSpeed="50.0" maxAcceleration="3.0" maxDeceleration="8.0"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="1.4" y="0.0" z="0.7"/><Dimensions width="1.85" length="4.5" height="1.45"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
  </Entities>
  <Storyboard>
    <Init>
      <Actions>
        <Private entityRef="Ego">
          <PrivateAction>
            <TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-1" s="20.0"/></Position></TeleportAction>
          </PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$CruiseSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
        <Private entityRef="LeadVehicle">
          <PrivateAction>
            <TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-1" s="70.0"/></Position></TeleportAction>
          </PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$CruiseSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
      </Actions>
    </Init>
    <Story name="CruiseFollowStory">
      <Act name="SteadyFollowAct">
        <ManeuverGroup maximumExecutionCount="1" name="LeadCruiseGroup">
          <Actors selectTriggeringEntities="false">
            <EntityRef entityRef="LeadVehicle"/>
          </Actors>
          <Maneuver name="MaintainSpeedManeuver">
            <Event name="GentleDecelEvent" priority="overwrite" maximumExecutionCount="1">
              <Action name="DecelAction">
                <PrivateAction>
                  <LongitudinalAction>
                    <SpeedAction>
                      <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="linear" value="1.5" dynamicsDimension="rate"/>
                      <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="20.0"/></SpeedActionTarget>
                    </SpeedAction>
                  </LongitudinalAction>
                </PrivateAction>
              </Action>
              <StartTrigger>
                <ConditionGroup>
                  <Condition name="TimeTrig" delay="0.0" conditionEdge="rising">
                    <ByValueCondition><SimulationTimeCondition value="4.0" rule="greaterOrEqual"/></ByValueCondition>
                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>
              </StartTrigger>
            </Event>
          </Maneuver>
        </ManeuverGroup>
      </Act>
    </Story>
  </Storyboard>
</OpenSCENARIO>

title: Euro NCAP AEB Rear-End Braking Test
description: Euro NCAP Car-to-Car Rear Stationary (CCRs) autonomous emergency braking test scenario where Ego approaches a stopped GVT target at 50 km/h on a proving-ground straight track.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OpenSCENARIO>
  <FileHeader revMajor="1" revMinor="2" date="2026-11-24T12:00:00" description="Euro NCAP AEB CCRs 50 km/h Braking Test" author="Ansatz"/>
  <ParameterDeclarations>
    <ParameterDeclaration name="EgoInitSpeed" parameterType="double" value="13.89"/>
  </ParameterDeclarations>
  <RoadNetwork>
    <LogicFile filepath="test_track.xodr"/>
  </RoadNetwork>
  <Entities>
    <ScenarioObject name="Ego">
      <Vehicle name="Ego" vehicleCategory="car">
        <Performance maxSpeed="55.0" maxAcceleration="3.5" maxDeceleration="9.5"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="1.4" y="0.0" z="0.7"/><Dimensions width="1.85" length="4.6" height="1.45"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
    <ScenarioObject name="GVT_Target">
      <Vehicle name="GVT_Target" vehicleCategory="car">
        <Performance maxSpeed="40.0" maxAcceleration="2.5" maxDeceleration="8.0"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="1.35" y="0.0" z="0.7"/><Dimensions width="1.80" length="4.4" height="1.42"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
  </Entities>
  <Storyboard>
    <Init>
      <Actions>
        <Private entityRef="Ego">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-1" s="25.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$EgoInitSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
        <Private entityRef="GVT_Target">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-1" s="120.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="0.0"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
      </Actions>
    </Init>
    <Story name="AEB_EmergencyBrakeStory">
      <Act name="EmergencyStopAct">
        <ManeuverGroup maximumExecutionCount="1" name="EgoBrakeGroup">
          <Actors selectTriggeringEntities="false">
            <EntityRef entityRef="Ego"/>
          </Actors>
          <Maneuver name="FullBrakeManeuver">
            <Event name="TriggerAEBEvent" priority="overwrite" maximumExecutionCount="1">
              <Action name="EmergencyDecel">
                <PrivateAction>
                  <LongitudinalAction>
                    <SpeedAction>
                      <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="linear" value="8.5" dynamicsDimension="rate"/>
                      <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="0.0"/></SpeedActionTarget>
                    </SpeedAction>
                  </LongitudinalAction>
                </PrivateAction>
              </Action>
              <StartTrigger>
                <ConditionGroup>
                  <Condition name="BrakeTime" delay="0.0" conditionEdge="rising">
                    <ByValueCondition><SimulationTimeCondition value="4.5" rule="greaterOrEqual"/></ByValueCondition>
                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>
              </StartTrigger>
            </Event>
          </Maneuver>
        </ManeuverGroup>
      </Act>
    </Story>
  </Storyboard>
</OpenSCENARIO>

title: Highway Cut-In Maneuver with Speed Trigger
description: Three-lane motorway cut-in scenario where an overtaking sedan merges abruptly into the Ego lane ahead of the Ego vehicle, exercising lateral lane-change dynamics and ACC response.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OpenSCENARIO>
  <FileHeader revMajor="1" revMinor="2" date="2026-11-24T12:00:00" description="Highway 3-Lane Cut-In Maneuver" author="Ansatz"/>
  <ParameterDeclarations>
    <ParameterDeclaration name="EgoSpeed" parameterType="double" value="30.0"/>
    <ParameterDeclaration name="ChallengerSpeed" parameterType="double" value="33.5"/>
  </ParameterDeclarations>
  <RoadNetwork>
    <LogicFile filepath="highway_3lane.xodr"/>
  </RoadNetwork>
  <Entities>
    <ScenarioObject name="Ego">
      <Vehicle name="Ego" vehicleCategory="car">
        <Performance maxSpeed="60.0" maxAcceleration="3.5" maxDeceleration="9.0"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="1.4" y="0.0" z="0.7"/><Dimensions width="1.85" length="4.6" height="1.45"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
    <ScenarioObject name="CutInCar">
      <Vehicle name="CutInCar" vehicleCategory="car">
        <Performance maxSpeed="60.0" maxAcceleration="4.0" maxDeceleration="9.0"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="1.4" y="0.0" z="0.7"/><Dimensions width="1.85" length="4.5" height="1.42"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
  </Entities>
  <Storyboard>
    <Init>
      <Actions>
        <Private entityRef="Ego">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-2" s="30.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$EgoSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
        <Private entityRef="CutInCar">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-1" s="65.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$ChallengerSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
      </Actions>
    </Init>
    <Story name="CutInStory">
      <Act name="CutInAct">
        <ManeuverGroup maximumExecutionCount="1" name="CutInGroup">
          <Actors selectTriggeringEntities="false">
            <EntityRef entityRef="CutInCar"/>
          </Actors>
          <Maneuver name="MergeIntoCenterLane">
            <Event name="LaneChangeEvent" priority="overwrite" maximumExecutionCount="1">
              <Action name="MergeRight">
                <PrivateAction>
                  <LateralAction>
                    <LaneChangeAction>
                      <LaneChangeActionDynamics dynamicsShape="sinusoidal" value="2.5" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                      <LaneChangeTarget><AbsoluteTargetLane value="-2"/></LaneChangeTarget>
                    </LaneChangeAction>
                  </LateralAction>
                </PrivateAction>
              </Action>
              <StartTrigger>
                <ConditionGroup>
                  <Condition name="CutInTime" delay="0.0" conditionEdge="rising">
                    <ByValueCondition><SimulationTimeCondition value="3.0" rule="greaterOrEqual"/></ByValueCondition>
                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>
              </StartTrigger>
            </Event>
          </Maneuver>
        </ManeuverGroup>
      </Act>
    </Story>
  </Storyboard>
</OpenSCENARIO>

title: Pedestrian Crosswalk Occlusion Scenario
description: Urban vulnerable road user (VRU) scenario where a pedestrian emerges from behind a parked delivery van at a crosswalk as the Ego vehicle approaches at 40 km/h.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OpenSCENARIO>
  <FileHeader revMajor="1" revMinor="2" date="2026-11-24T12:00:00" description="Urban Pedestrian Crosswalk Occlusion AEB Test" author="Ansatz"/>
  <ParameterDeclarations>
    <ParameterDeclaration name="EgoSpeed" parameterType="double" value="11.11"/>
    <ParameterDeclaration name="PedWalkSpeed" parameterType="double" value="1.5"/>
  </ParameterDeclarations>
  <RoadNetwork>
    <LogicFile filepath="urban_intersection.xodr"/>
  </RoadNetwork>
  <Entities>
    <ScenarioObject name="Ego">
      <Vehicle name="Ego" vehicleCategory="car">
        <Performance maxSpeed="50.0" maxAcceleration="3.2" maxDeceleration="9.5"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="1.4" y="0.0" z="0.7"/><Dimensions width="1.85" length="4.5" height="1.45"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
    <ScenarioObject name="ParkedVan">
      <Vehicle name="ParkedVan" vehicleCategory="van">
        <Performance maxSpeed="35.0" maxAcceleration="2.0" maxDeceleration="7.5"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="1.8" y="0.0" z="1.1"/><Dimensions width="2.10" length="5.6" height="2.35"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
    <ScenarioObject name="CrossingPedestrian">
      <Pedestrian name="CrossingPedestrian" pedestrianCategory="pedestrian" mass="75.0">
        <BoundingBox><Center x="0.0" y="0.0" z="0.88"/><Dimensions width="0.50" length="0.50" height="1.75"/></BoundingBox>
      </Pedestrian>
    </ScenarioObject>
  </Entities>
  <Storyboard>
    <Init>
      <Actions>
        <Private entityRef="Ego">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-1" s="15.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$EgoSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
        <Private entityRef="ParkedVan">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><WorldPosition x="72.0" y="-4.8" z="0.0" h="0.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
        </Private>
        <Private entityRef="CrossingPedestrian">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><WorldPosition x="80.0" y="-5.2" z="0.0" h="1.5708"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
        </Private>
      </Actions>
    </Init>
    <Story name="PedestrianCrossStory">
      <Act name="CrosswalkAct">
        <ManeuverGroup maximumExecutionCount="1" name="PedWalkGroup">
          <Actors selectTriggeringEntities="false">
            <EntityRef entityRef="CrossingPedestrian"/>
          </Actors>
          <Maneuver name="StepIntoCrosswalk">
            <Event name="WalkStartEvent" priority="overwrite" maximumExecutionCount="1">
              <Action name="WalkAction">
                <PrivateAction>
                  <LongitudinalAction>
                    <SpeedAction>
                      <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="linear" value="1.5" dynamicsDimension="rate"/>
                      <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$PedWalkSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
                    </SpeedAction>
                  </LongitudinalAction>
                </PrivateAction>
              </Action>
              <StartTrigger>
                <ConditionGroup>
                  <Condition name="WalkTrigger" delay="0.0" conditionEdge="rising">
                    <ByValueCondition><SimulationTimeCondition value="2.5" rule="greaterOrEqual"/></ByValueCondition>
                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>
              </StartTrigger>
            </Event>
          </Maneuver>
        </ManeuverGroup>
      </Act>
    </Story>
  </Storyboard>
</OpenSCENARIO>

title: Multi-Agent Highway Platoon Overtaking with Catalog
description: Multi-agent curved-highway scenario with an autonomous truck platoon, an overtaking Ego passenger car executing a coordinated double lane change, a curved OpenDRIVE motorway, and a reusable VehicleCatalog.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OpenSCENARIO>
  <FileHeader revMajor="1" revMinor="2" date="2026-11-24T12:00:00" description="Multi-Agent Highway Platoon Overtaking Scenario" author="Ansatz"/>
  <ParameterDeclarations>
    <ParameterDeclaration name="PlatoonSpeed" parameterType="double" value="22.22"/>
    <ParameterDeclaration name="EgoOvertakeSpeed" parameterType="double" value="33.33"/>
  </ParameterDeclarations>
  <CatalogLocations>
    <VehicleCatalog><Directory path="VehicleCatalog.xosc"/></VehicleCatalog>
  </CatalogLocations>
  <RoadNetwork>
    <LogicFile filepath="highway_curve.xodr"/>
  </RoadNetwork>
  <Entities>
    <ScenarioObject name="Ego">
      <Vehicle name="Ego" vehicleCategory="car">
        <Performance maxSpeed="60.0" maxAcceleration="4.0" maxDeceleration="9.5"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="1.4" y="0.0" z="0.7"/><Dimensions width="1.85" length="4.6" height="1.45"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
    <ScenarioObject name="TruckLead">
      <Vehicle name="TruckLead" vehicleCategory="truck">
        <Performance maxSpeed="30.0" maxAcceleration="1.5" maxDeceleration="6.5"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="3.5" y="0.0" z="1.7"/><Dimensions width="2.55" length="12.0" height="3.60"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
    <ScenarioObject name="TruckFollow">
      <Vehicle name="TruckFollow" vehicleCategory="truck">
        <Performance maxSpeed="30.0" maxAcceleration="1.5" maxDeceleration="6.5"/>
        <BoundingBox><Center x="3.5" y="0.0" z="1.7"/><Dimensions width="2.55" length="12.0" height="3.60"/></BoundingBox>
      </Vehicle>
    </ScenarioObject>
  </Entities>
  <Storyboard>
    <Init>
      <Actions>
        <Private entityRef="Ego">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-2" s="20.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$EgoOvertakeSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
        <Private entityRef="TruckFollow">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-2" s="75.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$PlatoonSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
        <Private entityRef="TruckLead">
          <PrivateAction><TeleportAction><Position><LanePosition roadId="1" laneId="-2" s="115.0"/></Position></TeleportAction></PrivateAction>
          <PrivateAction>
            <LongitudinalAction>
              <SpeedAction>
                <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0.0" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                <SpeedActionTarget><AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="$PlatoonSpeed"/></SpeedActionTarget>
              </SpeedAction>
            </LongitudinalAction>
          </PrivateAction>
        </Private>
      </Actions>
    </Init>
    <Story name="PlatoonOvertakeStory">
      <Act name="OvertakeAct">
        <ManeuverGroup maximumExecutionCount="1" name="EgoOvertakeGroup">
          <Actors selectTriggeringEntities="false">
            <EntityRef entityRef="Ego"/>
          </Actors>
          <Maneuver name="PassPlatoonManeuver">
            <Event name="MoveToFastLane" priority="overwrite" maximumExecutionCount="1">
              <Action name="ShiftLeft">
                <PrivateAction>
                  <LateralAction>
                    <LaneChangeAction>
                      <LaneChangeActionDynamics dynamicsShape="sinusoidal" value="2.5" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                      <LaneChangeTarget><AbsoluteTargetLane value="-1"/></LaneChangeTarget>
                    </LaneChangeAction>
                  </LateralAction>
                </PrivateAction>
              </Action>
              <StartTrigger>
                <ConditionGroup>
                  <Condition name="PassStart" delay="0.0" conditionEdge="rising">
                    <ByValueCondition><SimulationTimeCondition value="2.0" rule="greaterOrEqual"/></ByValueCondition>
                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>
              </StartTrigger>
            </Event>
            <Event name="ReturnToRightLane" priority="overwrite" maximumExecutionCount="1">
              <Action name="ShiftRight">
                <PrivateAction>
                  <LateralAction>
                    <LaneChangeAction>
                      <LaneChangeActionDynamics dynamicsShape="sinusoidal" value="2.5" dynamicsDimension="time"/>
                      <LaneChangeTarget><AbsoluteTargetLane value="-2"/></LaneChangeTarget>
                    </LaneChangeAction>
                  </LateralAction>
                </PrivateAction>
              </Action>
              <StartTrigger>
                <ConditionGroup>
                  <Condition name="PassComplete" delay="0.0" conditionEdge="rising">
                    <ByValueCondition><SimulationTimeCondition value="11.0" rule="greaterOrEqual"/></ByValueCondition>
                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>
              </StartTrigger>
            </Event>
          </Maneuver>
        </ManeuverGroup>
      </Act>
    </Story>
  </Storyboard>
</OpenSCENARIO>
